notes:
Faster library start: the first page of releases loads sooner; covers, stats and badges fill in afterwards without blocking the grid.
Much faster Vault stats: the dashboard reads pre-computed per-container statistics instead of re-scanning every container on each open. The Vault tab is fast even on large or external-drive vaults; a background pass keeps figures current and a Refresh dedup stats action recomputes on demand.
More accurate savings: deduplication now counts both data shared across archives and repeated data inside a single archive, so the Saved and dedup figures reflect the real space reclaimed.
Clearer loading state: while vault statistics are still being computed, the dashboard shows placeholders instead of a wall of zeros.
